selection.required: Original and replay HTTP 200, bounded capture timestamp, matching CDX digest and raw XML. An XML page chain is incomplete until every continuation is covered.
selection.replay_network: Wayback only, id_ replay, no redirects, byte inspection without executing JavaScript.
selection.requests: curl.exe GET. CDX timeout 16 seconds, maximum body 1000000 bytes. HTML reference replay timeout 22 seconds, maximum body 500000 bytes. Four follow-up replays timeout 30 seconds, maximum body 2500000 bytes. --max-redirs 0 on every request.

fallback.use: Discovery names and reported onboard dates only. Missing or truncated rows provide no negative evidence.
